notes: Partial run. WebFetch only opened URLs that surfaced in search results (PROVENANCE_REQUIRED otherwise), and search was dominated by AgendaPro/aggregators, so only clinics whose own site could be opened were added. No duty rota or animal poison line found: CITUC (UC) page lists toxicological emergencies +56 2 2635 3800 but does not mention animals, so no poison_line entry. Not reachable: veterinaria.uchile.cl, facultades.unab.cl (redirect), cituc.uc.cl, vet24chile.cl (robots), veterinariantakari.cl (robots), nuevadogtoraflaca.cl (robots), hospitalveterinariocde.cl (robots), centrovetvalpo.cl (robots), hospitalveterinariotalcahuano.skedu.com (error), vanguardiavet.cl (account suspended), cruzazul.cl (redirect loop). Inmevet (Maipú/Ñuñoa, advertises 24/7) and vet24chile.cl, Hospital Veterinario CDE, Centro Médico Veterinario Valparaíso, Hospital Veterinario Talcahuano (Villa Animal), Cedivet / SOS Vet / Hospital Veterinario Concepción (Concepción), Hospital Veterinario Hualpén, Nueva Dogtora Flaca (Antofagasta), Antakari (La Serena) are candidates still to confirm from reachable own pages. Nothing usable found for Iquique, Arica (private), Osorno, Puerto Varas, Pucón, Coquimbo, Antofagasta 24 h beyond aggregators. Royal Pets (La Serena) has only title/meta evidence for 24/7 and no address/phone: verify. Vet24 Ñuñoa publishes a 51 (La Serena) area-code phone: verify.
